title: Vendor Metric Key
description: The key of one vendor metric value: vendor, metric ID, and optional qualifier.

vendor.description: Vendor of the `vendor_metric_values[]` row. Matches the row's `vendor`.

metric_id.description: Metric of the `vendor_metric_values[]` row. Matches the row's `metric_id`.

qualifier.description: The row's `qualifier`, repeated verbatim when the row carries one. Omit when the row has none.
